user.title: NextFloor
user.description: Adds a sidebar page where you draw your home and see it in 3D.

ask.name: Ask the house
ask.description: Answers questions about the plan and the house: show a room or device, where something is, what is open, which lights are on. Showing also flies every open NextFloor view there.

text.name: Text
text.description: The question or command, in German or English.

language.name: Language
language.description: de or en (default: Home Assistant's language).
